description: This file defines the Settings class for generating settings XML for an OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS) file. It manages the serialization of spreadsheet view and worksheet settings, including active sheet, freeze panes, and selected cells.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Handles writing the settings.xml file for an ODS spreadsheet, configuring view and worksheet settings, including freeze panes and selected cells.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates the XML string for the settings.xml, including document settings, worksheet views, freeze panes, and active sheet indicator.

methods.name: writeAllWorksheetSettings
methods.description: Iterates over all worksheets in the spreadsheet to write individual worksheet settings into the XML.

methods.name: writeWorksheetSettings
methods.description: Writes settings for a specific worksheet, such as its title, selected cells, and freeze panes.

methods.name: writeSelectedCells
methods.description: Serializes the selected cells' position into XML attributes.

methods.name: writeSplitValue
methods.description: Helper method to write a specific split or setting value as an XML element.

methods.name: writeFreezePane
methods.description: Serializes freeze pane settings based on the worksheet's freeze pane cell address.
